name: spaghetti and meatballs
instructions:
SPAGHETTI AND MEATBALLS — split back out of [[italian-tomato-sauce]] into its own file 2026-11-18 (variant there since the 2026-11-13 merge; its own file before that). UNATTEMPTED.

Real meatballs in a crushed-tomato sauce over spaghetti. The meatballs are a classic panade build; the sauce base is CRUSHED TOMATOES (fire-roasted walked back 2026-11-18 — better for mexican/indian; see the tomato ruling), sharpened with RED WINE VINEGAR and OREGANO. NO ONIONS ANYWHERE in this dish.

=== THE MEATBALLS (WHAT GOES INSIDE) ===

- ground beef
- MILK-SOAKED (stale) BREAD — the panade
- black pepper
- fresh parsley, chopped
- PARMESAN CHEESE, grated
- GRATED GARLIC
- salt

Mix, shape into meatballs, and brown in olive oil.

=== THE SAUCE ===

- white wine (for the deglaze)
- crushed tomatoes
- red wine vinegar
- oregano

DEGLAZE the browned meatballs with WHITE WINE before adding the crushed tomatoes. Then the vinegar and oregano; simmer until thickened.

=== SERVE ===

Toss with spaghetti.
notes:
=== SPLIT BACK OUT 2026-11-18 ===

Merged into [[italian-tomato-sauce]] 2026-11-13 as a variant; split back into its own file 2026-11-18 (near-verbatim), alongside [[bolognese]].

=== TOMATO RULING — ALL ITALIAN TOMATO SAUCES (2026-11-18) ===

FRESH TOMATOES ARE TOO RAW AND SOUR — they don't give enough umami on their own. CANNED CHUNKY TOMATOES WITH TOMATO PASTE, or CANNED TOMATO SAUCE, are ideal (here: CRUSHED TOMATOES are the base, per this dish's own ruling). FIRE-ROASTED canned tomatoes aren't right either — better flavor profile for MEXICAN and INDIAN food. (Shared ruling with [[italian-tomato-sauce]] and [[bolognese]].)

=== RENAMED (SEPTEMBER 2026) ===

Formerly 'fire roasted meatballs' — renamed now that fire-roasted is the optional smoky direction rather than the identity, and the dish is the classic. (Before that it was an impossible-meat build; git history has both.)

=== THE MEATBALL INTERIOR — THE FULL STACK ===

Inside the meatballs: milk-soaked bread, pepper, parsley, parmesan cheese, and grated garlic (plus the beef and salt). The bread-in-milk panade keeps them tender; the parmesan and garlic season from within; parsley is the herb inside the meatball, oregano the herb on the sauce side.

=== NO ONIONS — ANYWHERE ===

Onions shouldn't appear anywhere in this dish — not in the meatballs, not in the sauce. Clashing.

=== SAUCE — CRUSHED TOMATOES (FIRE-ROASTED WALKED BACK 2026-11-18) ===

Crushed tomatoes are the base. Crushed FIRE-ROASTED tomatoes were the equally valid smoky direction — WALKED BACK by the all-sauces tomato ruling: fire-roasted has a better flavor profile for mexican and indian food. Red wine vinegar and oregano are both primary — the vinegar sharpens the sauce. Tomato paste stays out.

=== SIBLING RECIPES ===

- [[bolognese]]: the other ragu — ground meat loose in the sauce rather than shaped. The meatball-per-forkful format is what this recipe is for.
- [[italian-tomato-sauce]]: the protein-free tomato-sauce house (gnocchi, vodka, porcini).
